title: What Does Weight-Space Programming Add to Diffusion Editing? Program Construction versus Score-Guided Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2611.22228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space programming (WSP) lets a language model construct executable weight updates for another network. We study diffusion concept editing through an interface in which programs define training contexts, preservation constraints and update directions, while a shared numerical fitter selects their coefficients. We compare generated programs with published editors, a shared-panel hand-written baseline and budget-matched search over conventional edits on 24 TIMED test edits for Stable Diffusion 1.4. The preregistered rewrite pipeline shows no advantage over the strong baseline. In an exploratory comparison, one-shot Astra programs improve fresh-scene VLM joint success, which requires subject presence together with whole-image target matching, by +10.0 points over the shared-panel baseline, while CLIP relative match shows no detectable change. These programs organise adjustable directions around protected text-state subspaces. Probing

translated_title: 权重空间编程能为扩散模型编辑带来什么？程序构造与得分引导精细化之比较
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程让语言模型能够为另一个网络构建可执行的权重更新。我们通过一个接口来研究扩散概念编辑：程序定义训练上下文、保留约束和更新方向，而共享的数值拟合器负责选择其系数。我们在 Stable Diffusion 1.4 的 24 个 TIMED 测试编辑上，将生成的程序与已发表的编辑器、共享面板的手写基线以及预算匹配的传统编辑搜索进行比较。预注册的重写流水线相比强基线没有显示出优势。在探索性比较中，一次性生成的 Astra 程序在全新场景 VLM 联合成功率（要求主体出现且整图目标匹配）上比共享面板基线提升了 10.0 分，而 CLIP 相对匹配度则未检测到变化。这些程序围绕受保护的文本状态子空间来组织可调节的更新方向。
tldr: 该研究发现，预注册对比下语言模型生成的权重空间程序并不优于强基线编辑器，但探索性实验表明一次性生成的程序可通过围绕受保护文本状态子空间组织更新方向，将扩散概念编辑在全新场景下的 VLM 联合成功率提升 10 分。
en_tdlr: This study shows that weight-space programs generated by language models offer no advantage over strong baseline editors under preregistered comparison, but exploratory tests reveal that one-shot programs can boost fresh-scene VLM joint success in diffusion concept editing by +10 points by organizing adjustable update directions around protected text-state subspaces.
